notes.sound: A triangle under a hollow square an octave below, legato glide; round, with a short filter kick that velocity controls, and a slow per-voice drift so held notes breathe.
notes.shows: Legato, half keytracking, velocity into cutoff and the kick, a little drift.

notes.sound: Saw and a narrow pulse through a resonant filter with a big, fast envelope; mono so every note retriggers, a short glide for slides. Accents open it and ring longer; pressure screams; the wheel is a resonance pedal.
notes.shows: Velocity into the envelope amount, cutoff and decay; aftertouch to cutoff; wheel to resonance; mono retrigger.

notes.sound: Two saws 11 cents apart, each voice a touch different, beating against a dark filter that the drift LFO keeps nudging. Pressure growls, velocity bites.
notes.shows: Per-voice spread and drift so the beat never settles; aftertouch to cutoff and resonance.

notes.sound: Oscillator A synced to B an octave below; Env 3 drops A's pitch from 9 semitones up over 250 ms: the sync punch, mono, with the punch longer and the filter brighter on hard notes.
notes.shows: Sync swept by Env 3 into Pitch A; velocity into Env 3's decay, cutoff and level.

notes.sound: Two saws an octave apart, every voice a few cents its own, a medium filter envelope with a little resonance: the workhorse for stabs and chords, alive instead of flat.
notes.shows: Per-voice spread, drift, velocity into cutoff, the envelope amount and the VCA.

notes.sound: Saw and square an octave apart, LFO 1 (triangle) swinging the filter 30 semitones in quarter notes from the clock; the wheel speeds the wobble to 16ths, pressure adds resonance, velocity opens.
notes.shows: Clock-synced LFO 1 (1/4) retriggered on the first key, the wheel into the LFO rate, aftertouch to resonance.

notes.sound: A pulse under slow width modulation over a saw an octave down, legato; LFO 2 drifts the width per voice at its own pace, and pressure widens it. Thick without being static.
notes.shows: LFO 1 → PW with LFO 2 (drift, per voice) also into PW A; legato glide; aftertouch to pulse width.

notes.sound: Saw with a triangle an octave down. Env 3 kicks oscillator A's pitch 3 semitones at the start of each note and falls back in 60 ms, and Env 4 lets B frequency-modulate A for a 150 ms growl; harder notes growl harder. Both envelopes return to zero, so the note stays in tune once the transient is over.
notes.shows: Env 3 into Pitch A as a kick, poly-mod with Env 4 into the osc B amount; velocity into Env 4's decay (a held source into the osc B amount would keep the FM on and the note sharp).

notes.sound: A synced to B, the filter envelope sweeping A 20 semitones through poly-mod, legato glide. Vibrato waits 300 ms and fades in; pressure adds more and opens the filter; harder notes sweep further.
notes.shows: Sync and poly-mod envelope, LFO 1 delay and fade, aftertouch to vibrato and cutoff, velocity to the sweep.

notes.sound: Both layers on every note: layer 1 two saws 6 cents flat, layer 2 the same 6 cents sharp with a slower attack, so every note is four oscillators drifting around each other. Vibrato fades in late; pressure spreads them further.
notes.shows: Stack mode as a chorus; per-voice spread; LFO fade; aftertouch into B's pitch on both layers.

notes.sound: Saw with a pulse an octave up, resonance high, mono. Pressure opens the filter, raises the resonance and adds vibrato all at once through Macro 1; the wheel does the same gently. Velocity sets the bite.
notes.shows: Macro 1 fed by aftertouch and the wheel, fanning out to cutoff, resonance and LFO depth.

notes.sound: Two pulses at 35 % and 62 % width, 10 cents apart, LFO 2 slowly moving both widths per voice; press for a clock-synced octave trill from LFO 1's square. Soft filter with keytracking so the top stays round.
notes.shows: LFO 2 (sine, per voice) into both pulse widths; LFO 1 square synced to 1/8 into pitch, depth from aftertouch.

notes.sound: Triangles an octave apart, a resonant, open filter: a whistle. Env 4 scoops each note up a semitone in 90 ms, faster on hard notes; vibrato fades in; the filter follows the key fully so high notes sing.
notes.shows: Env 4 into pitch, velocity into Env 4's decay, LFO delay and fade, full keytracking.

notes.sound: Saws an octave apart, legato with a long glide that shortens with velocity: slow slides into soft notes, snappy ones into hard. Per-voice drift keeps the two oscillators moving; pressure brightens.
notes.shows: Velocity into glide time (negative: harder is faster), drift, aftertouch to cutoff.

notes.sound: Two saws 7 cents apart, the filter opening over 60 ms into a 30-semitone envelope; velocity makes the attack snap and the sweep bigger; vibrato arrives late; CC 2 (breath) rides the cutoff for a wind player's swell.
notes.shows: Velocity into the filter attack time, the envelope amount and level; CC B (breath) to cutoff; LFO delay and fade.

notes.sound: Saw and pulse, legato with glide; every note lands with a slightly different cutoff, pitch and width, as if played by hand, and the drift LFO keeps it moving while it's held. Pressure for vibrato.
notes.shows: Random into cutoff, pitch and PW per note; the drift LFO per voice; aftertouch to vibrato.

notes.sound: Saw and a width-modulated pulse, every voice a few cents and a little width its own, a soft filter that velocity opens. LFO 2 drifts each voice slowly; the drift setting adds the rest. Chords spread, nothing holds still.
notes.shows: Per-voice spread of pitch, the drift LFO per voice, drift, velocity to cutoff and level.

notes.sound: Two saws 8 cents apart on layer 1, a third saw an octave up on layer 2 at a lower level, both with a 40 ms filter attack into a 28-semitone sweep that velocity scales. Stacked, so each note is three saws; pressure swells.
notes.shows: Stack as a layered brass; velocity into the envelope amount and attack; aftertouch to cutoff on both layers.

notes.sound: Two squares an octave apart, filter wide open, instant envelopes; the filter envelope gives a 40 ms click at each key, LFO 2 a tremolo, and a slow vibrato fades in after a while. Pressure deepens the tremolo.
notes.shows: The filter envelope as a click transient, LFO 2 into the VCA (tremolo), LFO 1 delay and fade.

notes.sound: Synced saws with a 10-semitone poly-mod sweep from the filter envelope: hard-edged chords, deeper sweeps on harder notes, and every voice's sync pitch a few cents apart so the edge shimmers. Pressure pushes the sweep further.
notes.shows: Sync and poly-mod with velocity into the poly-mod amount; per-voice spread; aftertouch into poly-mod.

notes.sound: Soft triangles, B an octave up and quiet for the tine; a fast filter bark (+24 semitones, 300 ms decay to a closed sustain) over a long amp decay. Harder notes bark brighter and louder; a slow sine tremolo under it, deeper with pressure.
notes.shows: Velocity into cutoff, filter envelope amount and the VCA at once; LFO 2 as tremolo with aftertouch on its depth; full keytracking; a little drift.

notes.sound: Two saws 10 cents apart, filter fairly closed, a slow swell from Env 3 after the attack; pressing a key opens the filter, adds resonance and widens the detune (Macro 1), so a held chord blooms under the hand.
notes.shows: Env 3 as a slow swell; aftertouch into Macro 1 fanning to cutoff, resonance and B's pitch.

notes.sound: Two saws with heavy drift and a slow per-voice drift LFO on pitch and cutoff; every voice a different width and pitch offset; a soft filter. The worn-out polysynth: nothing in tune, everything pleasant.
notes.shows: Drift at 55, per-voice spread, the drift LFO, random cutoff per note.

notes.sound: Saw and pulse through a resonant filter; Env 3 cycles in quarter notes from the clock, opening and closing the filter in a rhythmic wah while a key is held; velocity sets how far it opens, pressure the resonance.
notes.shows: A cycling envelope synced to the clock into the cutoff; velocity into its depth via Macro 1.

notes.sound: Two saws 9 cents apart, each voice its own few cents, a slow attack; the filter breathes with LFO 2 (sine, 7 s) while a slower drift moves B's pitch per voice. Velocity shapes the attack: hard notes bloom faster.
notes.shows: Two slow modulators at unrelated rates, per-voice spread, drift, velocity into the amp attack.

notes.sound: Both layers: layer 1 a pulse under slow PWM with a saw 11 cents away, layer 2 an octave up and quieter with its own PWM rate, 250 ms attack. Vibrato fades in over a second; pressure deepens it. An ensemble with no chorus.
notes.shows: Stack with two PWM rates, LFO 1 delay and fade on both layers, aftertouch to vibrato.

notes.sound: Saw with a narrow pulse an octave down; LFO 1 (sine, 4 bars of clock) sweeps the filter while LFO 2 (drift, per voice) walks the pulse width and B's pitch, and Env 3 swells the cutoff after each attack. Never the same twice.
notes.shows: Three modulators on three timescales: a clock-synced LFO, a per-voice drift LFO, a slow Env 3.

notes.sound: Two saws, the filter nearly closed; Env 3 cycles on its own (2.5 s up, 2 s hold, 3 s down, 1 s rest) opening the filter in slow waves while a key is held, and LFO 2 drifts each voice's pitch. Pressure lifts the floor.
notes.shows: A free-cycling envelope into the cutoff, the drift LFO per voice, aftertouch to cutoff.

notes.sound: Triangles a fifth apart with a touch of poly-mod FM that Env 4 fades out over two seconds, a resonant open filter with full keytracking; each voice a few cents apart. Bell-like on the attack, glassy after.
notes.shows: Env 4 into the poly-mod osc B amount (FM that decays), per-voice spread, the drift LFO.

notes.sound: A narrow pulse (18 %) slowly width-modulated over a saw an octave down, a dark filter with half keytracking; LFO 2 (sine) moves the width while LFO 1 vibrato fades in late. Pressure opens it like a swell pedal.
notes.shows: LFO 2 → PW on its own rate, LFO 1 delay and fade, aftertouch to cutoff.

notes.sound: Two saws with a 1.5 s swell that shrinks to about 200 ms when you hit hard, so the same patch is a pad or a stab by touch; the filter follows with its own slower swell from Env 3. Per-voice spread and drift underneath.
notes.shows: Velocity into the amp attack time (16× range), Env 3 as a second filter envelope, spread, drift.

notes.sound: Both layers on every key: layer 1 two saws 8 cents flat with a slow sine on the filter, layer 2 two saws 8 cents sharp an octave up at a lower level with a drift LFO per voice; the two layers breathe at different speeds. The biggest pad in the bank; pressure swells both.
notes.shows: Stack with unrelated modulation on each layer; aftertouch on both; velocity into both attacks.

notes.sound: A 20 % pulse with a wide pulse an octave up, a 30-semitone filter snap that velocity scales and lengthens; a 2 ms pitch click from Env 3 for the pick. Full keytracking keeps the top bright and thin.
notes.shows: Velocity into the envelope amount and the filter decay; Env 3 as a pitch click; keytracking.

notes.sound: Triangles two octaves apart with a little noise for the thumb, a 120 ms filter pluck and a 15 ms click from Env 3; every note a slightly different brightness (random) and the tine detuned per voice.
notes.shows: Random into cutoff per note, per-voice spread, Env 3 click, noise as the transient.

notes.sound: Saws an octave apart, a 24-semitone filter pluck and a long amp decay that velocity lengthens; each voice a few cents apart so arpeggios shimmer; a slow drift LFO keeps sustained notes alive.
notes.shows: Velocity into the filter decay and cutoff, per-voice spread, the drift LFO.

notes.sound: Saw and a 30 % pulse, an 80 ms filter snap and a 180 ms body: tight and dry; velocity opens it and a touch of random cutoff keeps repeated notes from sounding like a machine.
notes.shows: Velocity into cutoff and level; random into cutoff; half keytracking.

notes.sound: A triangle frequency-modulated by oscillator B at +22 semitones (an inharmonic 3.6:1), the FM index decaying with Env 4 over 900 ms and scaled by velocity; B itself silent. A long ring with a little per-voice drift.
notes.shows: Env 4 and velocity into the poly-mod osc B amount; the amp envelope nudging B's pitch for a bell's slight droop.

notes.sound: Saws an octave apart with no filter envelope of their own: velocity supplies the pluck (cutoff, bark and decay), so a soft note is a dull tap and a hard one a bright snap. Pressure after the note lets it swell back open.
notes.shows: Velocity into cutoff, envelope amount and decay; aftertouch to cutoff; per-voice spread.

notes.sound: Pulse and saw an octave up through a resonant pluck; cutoff, pulse width and decay change at random on every note, and LFO 2 (S&H, per voice) steps B's pitch slightly while a note rings. No two notes alike.
notes.shows: Random into three destinations, the S&H LFO per voice into pitch, velocity on top.

notes.sound: A triangle with a quiet square two octaves up (the bar's 4:1 partial) and a touch of noise for the mallet; a 60 ms filter pluck, a decay that shortens up the keyboard (note → decay) and lengthens with velocity.
notes.shows: Note number into the amp decay, velocity into the decay and cutoff, noise as the mallet.

notes.sound: Hold a key: a 16th-note octave bassline in that key, saw plus square an octave down, with lane A opening the filter over the bar. Accents on the downbeats.
notes.shows: The step sequencer from MIDI clock, note offsets, per-step velocity, an automation lane (Seq A) gliding into cutoff.

notes.sound: A 303-style line: one saw, resonance 70, a big fast filter envelope; ties slide (gate 100 %), accented steps hit the filter harder; lane A adds a slow filter rise.
notes.shows: Ties/slides, accents through velocity into the filter envelope amount, mono glide, a lane on cutoff.

notes.sound: Hold a chord: it arpeggiates upward in 16ths, every fifth and eighth step jumping an octave. Saw plus a pulse an octave up, a short pluck.
notes.shows: The arpeggiator (up) with per-step note offsets transposing the arp note.

notes.sound: An eighth-note bass groove where some steps stutter (2, 3 or 4 ratchets) and two of them only play sometimes (4 and 6 in 8).
notes.shows: Ratchets and probability per step.

notes.sound: A 32-step 16th riff with rests; lane A glides the cutoff up and back over the two bars, lane B steps the pulse width every beat.
notes.shows: Two automation lanes: one smooth (Seq A into cutoff), one stepped (Seq B into PW A).

notes.sound: A 16-step eighth-note melody in minor pentatonic where half the steps play only sometimes; whatever key you hold, the scale quantizer keeps the transposed notes in C minor pentatonic.
notes.shows: Probability per step and scale quantize (pentatonic minor, root C).

notes.sound: An eighth-note walking bass with heavy swing, saw plus a triangle an octave down, a little glide; the filter drops when the keys are released.
notes.shows: Swing, mono glide, the Gate source (1 while a key is down).

notes.sound: Channel mode: channel 1 plays a sequenced 16th bass (layer 1, mono), channel 2 a legato lead with vibrato (layer 2). Only layer 1's keys start the sequence.
notes.shows: Channel layer mode, a sequence that takes layer 1's keys only, per-layer voice modes.

notes.sound: Pulse and saw a fifth apart through a screaming filter; LFO 1 (sample and hold at 8 Hz) throws pitch and cutoff around while LFO 2's falling ramp pulls the filter down. The wheel speeds it up.
notes.shows: The S&H shape on pitch and filter (buttons), the ramp-down shape, the wheel into the LFO rate.

notes.sound: Noise alone through a resonant filter wandered by two drift LFOs; low keys rumble, high keys whistle. Press to bring the storm closer.
notes.shows: Noise as the only source, the drift shape on both LFOs, Note into cutoff, aftertouch.

notes.sound: Synced saws; Env 4 drops the pitch two octaves in 300 ms while sweeping the sync: pew. Harder notes fall slower.
notes.shows: Env 4 into pitch at full depth (24 semitones) plus Pitch A for the sync sweep, velocity into Env 4's decay.

notes.sound: Low pulse, saw and noise chopped by a free-cycling amp envelope at about 12 Hz; the wheel slows the rotor, pressure opens the filter, a drift LFO moves it.
notes.shows: A cycling amp envelope (attack, hold, fall, rest) as a chopper, the mod wheel scaling its rest time.

notes.sound: Two squares an octave apart; LFO 1's triangle swings the pitch a full octave each way at 0.5 Hz, restarting with the first key. The wheel speeds it, pressure tames it.
notes.shows: A full-depth triangle LFO on pitch, retrigger on the first key, the wheel into the rate, aftertouch reducing depth.

notes.sound: Saw and pulse; LFO 1's step pattern (one bar of clock) jumps the pitch an octave between its high and low steps, snapped to minor pentatonic, while LFO 2 (S&H in 16ths) picks a new cutoff every step.
notes.shows: The Steps shape on pitch (via a route), S&H synced to 1/16 on the filter, scale quantize.

notes.sound: All eight voices in unison, saws an octave apart 45 cents spread, drift on top, a slow triangle on the filter and a per-voice drift LFO on pitch; 2 s swell. The wheel spreads the detune further.
notes.shows: Unison with detune, drift, LFO 2 drift per voice, the wheel into the Detune destination.

notes.sound: Oscillator B at +31 semitones modulates both oscillator A and the filter through poly-mod (filter FM), Env 4 adding more at the start; resonant and inharmonic, with each note's partials shifted a little.
notes.shows: Poly-mod into the filter (filter FM) as well as freq A, Env 4 adding poly-mod depth, random per-note detune of B.

notes.sound: Eight mono lines, one per MIDI channel 1-8, and no two alike: the channel number shapes the sound, from a dark, sustained, sliding bass on channel 1 to a bright, barking, snappy pluck with no glide on channel 8, the channels between grading from one to the other (a saw with a pulse an octave down throughout). Each channel has its own bend, pressure and CC 74 brightness. Made for sequencers that drive eight lines.
notes.shows: The 8ch layer mode; the voice-number source (voice = channel here) into cutoff, the filter envelope's amount, the sustains, decays and glide; Timbre (CC 74) and aftertouch per voice.

notes.sound: MPE (lower zone): each note on channels 2-9 has 48 semitones of bend, its slide (CC 74) opens its filter and its pressure brings in vibrato. Two saws 7 cents apart, soft attack.
notes.shows: The mpe layer mode; per-note Timbre, aftertouch and bend; per-voice LFOs.

notes.sound: A dry saw pluck that the mod wheel turns, knob by knob, into P25 Warm Pad (same oscillators, so only the sound moves); LFO 2 (one bar of clock) keeps it drifting a little between the two on its own.
notes.shows: The Morph destination: mod wheel and a synced LFO morphing towards another patch of the set by slot number.

notes.sound: Split at C3: below it a mono saw bass with a short filter envelope; from it up a legato lead with glide, an Env 4 scoop into each note and a late vibrato.
notes.shows: Split mode, per-layer voice modes, envelopes and routes (Env 4 into Pitch A on the lead only).

notes.sound: All eight voices on one note, saws an octave apart spread 45 cents with drift and a per-voice drift LFO; legato with glide. The wheel pulls the voices even further apart.
notes.shows: Unison (8 voices), detune, drift, legato glide, the wheel into Detune.

notes.sound: A saw pad cut into 16ths by LFO 1's step pattern over one bar of clock (the 'ta-ta-taa' gate), restarting with every chord; LFO 2 (sine, 2 bars) sweeps the filter underneath.
notes.shows: The Steps shape into the VCA at 99 (a trance gate), retrigger on every key, LFO 2 synced to 2 bars.

notes.sound: Hold a key or a chord and it plays itself: the amp and filter envelopes cycle in eighths from the clock, and each voice's own S&H LFO picks a new pitch every eighth, snapped to C minor pentatonic; a drift LFO moves the filter. Pressure speeds the dice.
notes.shows: Generative: S&H LFO into pitch with scale quantize, per-voice LFOs, synced cycling amp and filter envelopes, aftertouch into the LFO rate.

notes.sound: Saw and pulse. Macro 1 is 'brightness': the wheel feeds it (from a hand-set -20 offset) and it opens the cutoff, adds resonance and narrows pulse B. Macro 2 is 'motion': pressure and CC A (expression, CC 11) feed it, and it brings in vibrato, detunes B and adds noise.
notes.shows: Both macros as sums of several sources (with a per-layer offset) fanning out to three destinations each.
